The PR adds requester-side `plugin.approval.cancel` handling for aborted plugin approval waits and updates gateway, channel rendering, forwarder, SDK renderer, and tests for nullable cancelled approval resolutions.

PR surface: Source +185, Tests +120. Total +305 across 22 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source: current main has accepted two-phase plugin approvals that race `plugin.approval.waitDecision` against abort signals, and there is no requester-side cancel method to expire the accepted gateway record. I did not run a live reproduction in this read-only review.

target.title: fix: cancel aborted plugin approvals
target.body:
﻿Fixes #98576.

## Summary
- add `plugin.approval.cancel` as a requester-side terminal RPC for pending plugin approvals
- cancel accepted plugin approval ids when the agent run aborts during `waitDecision`
- broadcast nullable `plugin.approval.resolved` cleanup events and render cancelled plugin approvals safely
- cover cancel routing, runtime identity, forwarder/renderer behavior, and abort cleanup

## Tests
